user.title: Set up utility statements
user.description: One entry per property. You can add gas and water later from Configure.

data_description.title: Used for the device and notifications, for example 'Flat 2'.

supply.title: {supply} supply
supply.description: Prices as on the landlord's bill. All amounts include VAT; VAT isn't shown on the statement.

data_description.sensor: The meter's total (cumulative) sensor, for example the Shelly EM1 total energy sensor.
data_description.unit: Most UK gas meters read in m³. Smart meters that report kWh need no conversion.
data_description.unit_rate: From the landlord's bill, including VAT.
data_description.cf: Shown on the gas bill; usually 1.02264.
data_description.cv: Shown on the gas bill; usually around 39 to 40 MJ/m³.
data_description.clean_rate: Price per m³ from the water bill.
data_description.waste_rate: Price per m³ from the water bill. Set to 0 if not charged.
data_description.waste_pct: Most water companies charge wastewater on 95% or 100% of water used.
data_description.standing: Daily charge from the bill, including VAT. Only used when the switch above is on.
data_description.effective_from: If you change any price, the new price applies from this date. Earlier days keep the old price.
data_description.initial_reading: The reading billing starts from. You can also add readings later on the device page.
data_description.monthly: Charged in full for a whole month. A part month is charged by days, for example 10 of 30 days.

schedule.title: Schedule and sending

data.start_day: Period starts on day of month

data_description.start_day: Monthly and quarterly cycles only (1 to 28).
data_description.send_time: The statement is created at this time on the day after the period ends.
data_description.notify_service: Used for approval requests and meter reading requests. Leave blank for Home Assistant notifications only.
data_description.billing_start: First day to bill, for example the tenancy start date. The first statement covers from this day to the end of that period. Changing it later restarts billing from the new date.
data_description.sending_mode: With 'I'll print it', each statement is made as a PDF and you get a notification with a link to open and print it. Nothing is emailed, and no email or people details are needed.

schedule.description: Last step. Add people, payment details and email sending later from Configure; statements won't be emailed until they're filled in.

people.title: People and property

data_description.reference_prefix: Optional, for example FLAT2 gives FLAT2-0001.
data_description.tenant_email: The statement is sent to the tenant with the landlord copied in.

people.description: Fill in what you have now; you can add the rest later. The tenant's email is needed before statements can be sent.

payment.title: Payment details
payment.description: Shown on the statement so the tenant knows how to pay. Optional; leave blank to add later.

data_description.pay_within_days: Set to 0 to leave the due date off the statement.
data_description.note: Shown under the payment details, for example 'Please use the reference so the payment can be matched.'

email.title: Email sending
email.description: The mailbox statements are sent from.

data_description.from_email: Leave blank to use the username.
data_description.reply_to: Replies from the tenant go here. Usually the landlord.
data_description.smtp_password: For Gmail or Google Workspace use an app password.
data_description.test_email_to: If filled in, a test email is sent when you submit. Otherwise only the login is checked.

error.not_metered: This sensor has no long-term statistics. Pick a total or cumulative meter sensor.
error.wrong_unit_energy: This sensor isn't in energy units (kWh). Pick a different sensor or meter unit.
error.wrong_unit_volume: This sensor isn't in volume units (m³). Pick a different sensor or meter unit.
error.invalid_sort_code: Enter a 6-digit sort code, for example 12-34-56.
error.from_needed: Enter a from address, or use an email address as the username.

remove_supply.title: Remove a supply
remove_supply.description: Readings already entered are kept in case you add it back.

create_statement.name: Create statement for dates
create_statement.description: Create a one-off statement, for example when a tenant moves in or out. Follows the sending setting.

preview_statement.name: Preview statement
preview_statement.description: Make a preview PDF of the current period so far. Nothing is sent.

approve_statement.name: Approve and send statement
approve_statement.description: Send the statement waiting for approval.

discard_statement.name: Discard statement
discard_statement.description: Discard the pending statement. A regular period is skipped.

add_meter_reading.name: Add meter reading
add_meter_reading.description: Save a manual reading for a gas or water supply.
